title: 3D
summary: 3D scenes in the modern editorial style: flat picture panels painted with the kit's studio-light tones (the light is in the picture, no glow), white frames and heavy white type, on near-black charcoal with grain. Motion lands on the 0.2 s beat with expo-out snaps and small overshoots; nothing drifts. Pass "clear": true for a transparent canvas over footage.
usage: {"piece": "three/panel-ring"} or {"background": {"piece": "three/bokeh-sweep"}}. Most take tones (kit tone names) and some take images (stills) and word. Files: library/themes/modern/three/pieces/.

items.name: Lookbook strips
items.description: Five tall picture strips with staggered heights flip about their vertical axes on the beat, in a scattered order, turning to new pictures; a big word builds across them letter by letter and drops out. word, tones, backs, images.

items.name: Card slab
items.description: A deck of thin portrait picture cards seen three-quarter on fans open in depth card by card, turns a notch per beat, and closes back into one slab. count, tones.

items.name: Panel ring
items.description: A carousel of ten tall picture panels on a ring, turning one panel per bar with a hard landing; the front panel gets a thin white frame. Loops. word, tones, images.

items.name: Frame corridor
items.description: A slow even dolly down an endless gallery corridor of thin white portrait frames, studio-light pictures hanging on both walls and fading into the charcoal ahead. speed, tones.

items.name: Slab word
items.description: A big word built from tall white slabs (one per column of each heavy capital): letters drop in column by column in a scattered order, ghost until they lock solid, then drop out. word.

items.name: Bokeh sweep
items.description: Out-of-focus warm and cool studio light over charcoal with a broad white light sweep crossing on a diagonal and lifting the discs it passes. Loops. count, tones, sweeps.
